Traffic Shaping for Publishers

Optimize bid requests filtering out: no-value bid requests, browsers, low-viewability, ad units, and sizes. Increase your win rates with each SSP proving to be a valuable partner for them. Enhance your user experience while improving the SPO.

AI Dynamic Flooring

Built for first-price auctions to support all major platforms, providing transparency and outstanding results to DSPs, which is impossible with GAM and UPRs. Protect your inventory against low-quality ads, high operational expenses, and falling CPMs

Accurate Revenue Predictions

Automate AI predictions on all your key dimensions. Track holistic revenue in your CDP and buy platforms or fire session revenue-related pixels

AI Customization

Free up time and achieve better results by letting AI handle optimization towards YOUR goals with higher granularity and real-time market adjustments

Ready to Win? Discover Now!
